classes.label: Catalyst Mass Fraction In Ink Solids

classes.label: Catalyst material

classes.label: Catalyst Particle Volume

classes.label: Catalyst Ruthenium Mass Fraction

classes.label: Catalyst To Binder Mass Ratio

classes.description: A dimensionless characteristic expressing the stated ratio identified as Catalyst To Nafion Solution Mass Ratio.

classes.label: Catalyst Transfer Rate

classes.label: Categorical characteristic

classes.label: Cathode Catalyst Layer

classes.label: Cathode Catalyst Layer Thickness

classes.label: Cathode Gas Composition

classes.description: Mass of carbon material in the cathode microporous layer divided by the geometric area coated by that microporous layer.

classes.description: A property denoting description=Cathode resistance extracted from cathode ohmic drop during pulse (Ohm).

classes.description: An electrochemical conditioning process that restricts cathode oxygen supply under controlled operation to establish reducing or hydrogen-evolving cathode conditions for membrane-electrode activation.

classes.label: CCL accessible secondary-pore volume fraction

classes.label: CCL contact-angle-distribution data

classes.label: CCL hydrophobic-pore mean contact angle
classes.description: Pore-volume-weighted arithmetic mean of contact angles above 90 degrees, considering cathode-catalyst-layer pore volume remaining after ionomer filling.

classes.label: CCL mean contact angle
classes.description: Arithmetic mean of local cathode-catalyst-layer pore contact angles, with primary- and secondary-pore distributions weighted by their shares of total pore volume remaining after ionomer filling.

classes.label: CCL primary-pore geometric-mean radius
classes.description: Geometric mean, equal to the median, of the volume-weighted lognormal pore-radius distribution for primary pores in a cathode catalyst layer.

classes.label: CCL primary-pore logarithmic radius deviation
classes.description: Dimensionless standard deviation in the volume-weighted lognormal distribution of primary-pore radii, calculated using the natural logarithm.

classes.label: CCL primary-pore specific surface area
classes.description: Specific surface area of the primary-pore domain of the ionomer-free reference structure per unit carbon mass, calculated from the primary-pore size distribution.

classes.label: CCL primary-pore volume fraction
classes.description: Fraction of the total pore volume assigned to primary pores in the ionomer-free platinum-on-carbon structure of a cathode catalyst layer.

classes.label: CCL refined pore-size-distribution data
classes.description: Normalized pore-volume density per natural-logarithmic interval of pore radius, combining primary and secondary pores after accounting for ionomer filling.

classes.label: CCL refined pore-size-distribution dataset
classes.description: A dataset profile containing a pore-radius axis and corresponding refined CCL pore-size distribution.

classes.label: CCL secondary-pore geometric-mean radius
classes.description: Geometric mean, equal to the median, of the volume-weighted lognormal pore-radius distribution for secondary pores in a cathode catalyst layer.

classes.label: CCL secondary-pore hydrophobic volume fraction
classes.description: Fraction of secondary-pore volume with hydrophobic wetting behavior, corresponding to contact angles greater than 90 degrees.

classes.label: CCL secondary-pore logarithmic radius deviation
classes.description: Dimensionless standard deviation in the volume-weighted lognormal distribution of secondary-pore radii, calculated using the natural logarithm.

classes.label: CCL secondary-pore specific surface area
classes.description: Specific surface area of the secondary-pore domain of the ionomer-free reference structure per unit carbon mass, calculated from the secondary-pore size distribution.

classes.label: CCL secondary-pore volume fraction
classes.description: Fraction of the total pore volume assigned to secondary pores in the ionomer-free platinum-on-carbon structure of a cathode catalyst layer.

classes.label: CCL total-pore specific surface area
classes.description: Total specific surface area of the primary- and secondary-pore network of the ionomer-free cathode-catalyst-layer reference structure per unit carbon mass.

classes.label: CCL water-retention-curve dataset

classes.label: Cd Se Zn S Quantum Dot

classes.description: A rheological characteristic representing viscosity recovery shear rate high under the conditions and reference basis stated with the record.

classes.label: Viscosity Recovery Shear Rate Low
classes.description: A rheological characteristic representing viscosity recovery shear rate low under the conditions and reference basis stated with the record.

classes.label: Viscosity Recovery Time
classes.description: A property denoting characteristic time for ink to recover high viscosity after cessation of high shear (post-extrusion).

classes.label: Visible Light Lamp
classes.description: Light source used for visible-light irradiation during photodegradation/self-cleaning tests (paper mentions 300 W lamp).

classes.label: Visual Inspection Stability Measurement
classes.description: Qualitative stability test based on visually observed phase separation / settling time.

classes.label: Voltage Sensor
classes.description: Voltage sensing hardware used to record fuel cell voltage during aging tests.

classes.label: Volumetric ink deposition rate
classes.description: A volumetric-rate characteristic specifying the volume of ink deposited per unit time by a printing or dispensing process.

classes.label: Voxel Size
classes.description: The physical edge lengths of a voxel in a reconstructed three-dimensional image, specified along the three coordinate directions; for isotropic voxels the common edge length may be reported as a single value.

classes.label: Vulcan XC 72 R Carbon Black
classes.description: Commercial carbon black support used as model catalyst-layer carbon.

classes.label: Warburg Coefficient
classes.description: A property denoting warburg coefficient and determined in Electrochemical Impedance Spectroscopy Potentiostatic and Electrochemical Impedance Spectroscopy Galvanostatic.

classes.label: Warburg Impedance
classes.description: A property denoting warburg impedance and determined in Electrochemical Impedance Spectroscopy Potentiostatic.

classes.label: Water
classes.description: A solvent representing water under the conditions and reference basis stated with the record.

classes.label: Water Assisted Low Pressure CVD
classes.description: Chemical vapor deposition growth process for MWCNTs using ethylene and hydrogen with controlled water vapor at ~800°C under low pressure.

classes.label: Water Bath Temperature
classes.description: A thermal characteristic specifying the temperature associated with water bath.

classes.label: Water Content Measurement
classes.description: A measurement process that uses water content measurement to determine Water Content Fraction and Water Uptake Indicator using Karl Fischer Titrator.

classes.label: Water Diffusion Coefficient
classes.description: A property denoting dynamic diffusion coefficient for water uptake in PFSA membranes (Fickian diffusion coefficient).

classes.label: Water Drop Volume
classes.description: A geometric characteristic specifying the three-dimensional volume occupied by water drop.

classes.label: Water Mass Fraction In Solvent Mixture
classes.description: A composition characteristic expressing the stated fractional composition identified as Water Mass Fraction In Solvent Mixture.

classes.label: Water Storage Space Calculation
classes.description: An analysis that estimates the volume available to store water in an assembly or layer from a defined accessible-volume model and, when required, expresses that volume per stated reference area.

classes.label: Water To Isopropanol Molar Ratio
classes.description: A dimensionless characteristic expressing the stated ratio identified as Water To Isopropanol Molar Ratio.

classes.label: Water To Isopropanol Volume Ratio
classes.description: The volume of water divided by the volume of isopropanol used to prepare the specified solvent mixture.

classes.label: Water To N Propanol Volume Ratio
classes.description: The volume of water divided by the volume of n-propanol used to prepare the specified solvent mixture.

classes.label: Water To N Propanol Weight Ratio
classes.description: A dimensionless characteristic expressing the stated ratio identified as Water To N Propanol Weight Ratio.

classes.label: Water Vapor Adsorption Measurement
classes.description: Water vapor adsorption to estimate hydrophilicity and water uptake.

classes.label: Water Vapor Volumetric Flow Rate
classes.description: A transport characteristic specifying the quantity of water vapor volumetric passing a reference boundary per unit time.

classes.label: Water-to-nitrogen adsorption-capacity ratio
classes.description: A dimensionless sorption characteristic equal to the ratio of a material's maximum water-vapor adsorption capacity to its maximum nitrogen adsorption capacity under the stated conditions.

classes.label: Wavelength
classes.description: A geometric characteristic specifying the length of wavelength.

classes.label: Wavelength Cutoff
classes.description: A spectroscopic characteristic specifying wavelength cutoff under the conditions and reference basis stated with the record.

classes.label: Web Tension
classes.description: A quantitative characteristic specifying web tension under the conditions and reference basis stated with the record.

classes.label: Weight Average Molecular Weight
classes.description: A property denoting weight average molecular weight and determined in Gel Permeation Chromatography Measurement.

classes.label: Weight Increase After Impregnation
classes.description: A property denoting percent weight increase after colloidal silica immersion/impregnation.

classes.label: Wet Co Impregnation
classes.description: Catalyst preparation step to load Ni and P precursors onto porous alumina carrier from aqueous solution.

classes.label: Wetting Dip Time
classes.description: A temporal characteristic specifying the elapsed time associated with wetting dip.

classes.label: Wetting Solvent To Water Volume Ratio
classes.description: The volume of the identified wetting solvent divided by the volume of water used in the electrode-prewetting mixture.

classes.label: Workflow profile
classes.description: An information entity that specifies expected entities, relations, cardinalities, and validation rules for a scientific workflow record.

classes.label: Working Distance
classes.description: A geometric characteristic specifying working distance under the conditions and reference basis stated with the record.

classes.label: Working Time Deformation
classes.description: The amplitude of the oscillatory shear deformation applied during a rheological working-time evaluation.

classes.label: Working Time Duration
classes.description: A temporal characteristic specifying the duration of working time.

classes.label: Working Time Frequency
classes.description: A frequency characteristic specifying the repetition rate or oscillation frequency associated with working time.

classes.label: X Ray Beam Energy
classes.description: An energy characteristic specifying the energy associated with x ray beam.

classes.label: X Ray Computed Tomography Imaging
classes.description: 3D imaging measurement to quantify pore structure, porosity, and tortuosity in catalyst layers.

classes.label: X Ray Computed Tomography Measurement
classes.description: A measurement process that uses X-ray computed tomography to acquire tomographic projections and reconstructed volumes for porous electrochemical and related material systems.

classes.label: X Ray CT Instrument
classes.description: An instrument configuration for synchrotron and related X-ray computed tomography workflows that acquires tomographic projections and supports reconstructed-volume analysis for porous electrochemical and related material systems.

classes.label: X Ray Diffractometer
classes.description: X-ray diffractometer used to acquire diffraction patterns during catalyst and electrode material characterization.

classes.label: X Ray Microscope
classes.description: An instrument corresponding to a X ray microscope and used in X Ray Computed Tomography Measurement.

classes.label: X Ray Wavelength
classes.description: A geometric characteristic specifying the length of x ray.

classes.label: X-ray diffraction
classes.description: X-ray diffraction measurement used to characterize PEMFC-relevant catalyst powders and related electrode materials by recording diffraction patterns and deriving peak positions, peak widths, Pt crystallite size, and theoretical metal surface area.

classes.label: X-ray photoelectron spectroscopy
classes.description: Surface chemical analysis measurement used to characterize PEMFC-relevant catalyst powders, catalyst inks, ionomers, and related surface chemistries by acquiring XPS spectra and quantifying elemental composition and chemical-state information.

classes.label: Xenon Lamp
classes.description: Visible-light irradiation source for photocatalytic tests (UV cutoff filter at 400 nm).

classes.label: XPS Analysis Area
classes.description: A geometric characteristic specifying the area associated with xps analysis.

classes.label: XPS Dataset
classes.description: A dataset containing XPS spectra and related quantification outputs generated by X Ray Photoelectron Spectroscopy Measurement for PEMFC-relevant surface-chemistry characterization.

classes.label: XPS Instrument
classes.description: Instrument for X-ray photoelectron spectroscopy used to acquire XPS spectra and quantification data for PEMFC-relevant surface-chemistry characterization.

classes.label: XPS Pass Energy
classes.description: An energy characteristic specifying the energy associated with xps pass.

classes.label: XPS Take Off Angle
classes.description: A geometric characteristic specifying the angle associated with xps take off.

classes.label: XRD Pattern Dataset
classes.description: Dataset of X-ray diffraction patterns or diffractograms generated during catalyst and electrode material characterization.

classes.label: XRD Peak FWHM
classes.description: A property denoting xRD peak full width at half maximum (degrees).

classes.label: XRD Peak Position 2 Theta
classes.description: A property denoting xRD peak position expressed in 2θ angle (degrees).

classes.label: XRD Step Size
classes.description: A geometric characteristic specifying xrd step size under the conditions and reference basis stated with the record.

classes.label: XRD Two Theta End
classes.description: A quantitative characteristic specifying xrd two theta end under the conditions and reference basis stated with the record.

classes.label: XRD Two Theta Start
classes.description: A quantitative characteristic specifying xrd two theta start under the conditions and reference basis stated with the record.

classes.label: Xrite Optical Property Measurement
classes.description: A measurement process that uses xrite optical property measurement to determine Transparency, Delta S, and Color Difference Delta Eab using Xrite Spectrophotometer.

classes.label: Xrite Spectrophotometer
classes.description: Spectrophotometer used to measure optical properties (ΔE, etc.) of printed films (Section 2.4.1.5).

classes.label: XTM Scan Time
classes.description: A temporal characteristic specifying the elapsed time associated with xtm scan.

classes.label: XY Moving Stage
classes.description: A positioning component that translates a mounted specimen, substrate, or tool along two independently controlled orthogonal axes.

classes.label: Yield Stress
classes.description: A property denoting stress at which ink transitions from solid-like to liquid-like behavior (taken at G'/G" crossover).

classes.label: Youngs Modulus
classes.description: A property denoting young’s modulus of membrane (undoped/doped).

classes.label: Zero Shear Viscosity
classes.description: A property denoting zero shear viscosity and determined in Rheology Measurement.

classes.label: Zeta Potential
classes.description: A property denoting zeta potential of colloidal particles in ink; indicator of dispersion stability.

classes.label: Zeta Potential Analyzer
classes.description: An instrument that measures an electrokinetic response, commonly electrophoretic mobility, and estimates zeta potential using an appropriate electrokinetic model.

classes.label: Zeta Potential Measurement
classes.description: Measurement of zeta potential to assess colloidal stability of catalyst inks.

classes.label: Zeta Potential Stability Threshold
classes.description: A specified magnitude of zeta potential used as an operational electrostatic-stability criterion for a dispersion under stated medium, pH, ionic-strength and assessment conditions.

classes.label: ZIF 67
classes.description: Metal–organic framework precursor (ZIF-67) used as template/precursor to generate NCNTFs support during pyrolysis.

classes.label: Zirconia Milling Balls
classes.description: Zirconia (ZrO2) spherical milling media added during ball milling to enhance dispersion (paper uses 3 mm spheres).

classes.label: Zirconium Diboride Powder
classes.description: ZrB2 ceramic powder used as UHTC phase in DIW inks; average particle size reported before/after milling.
